events.body:
An off-route segment exists: 09:06–09:13, 4.84 km driven where the optimal route covers 0.00 km, reaching up to 1176 m from the optimal route [F3]. Under RD-1 that segment is a detour and must be individually tested against RD-3, RD-4 and RD-5; none of the exemptions applies here [F3][RD-1].

No rider-requested stop or rider-initiated reroute appears in the chat or elsewhere before the segment, so RD-3 cannot exempt it [F7][F8][F3][RD-3]. The driver never proposed a route change before leaving the optimal route and the rider never agreed, so RD-5 does not apply; the driver's claim that "my GPS rerouted me" is a post-hoc justification, not prior mutual agreement [F9][F3][RD-5]. No traffic incident was recorded near the route during the trip window [F12], and the Ayer Rajah Expressway band 5 and Central Expressway band 4 records are mild-congestion bands that, on their own, do not exempt under RD-4(b) [F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. So the 4.84 km segment remains an unexempted detour under RD-1 [F3][RD-1].

The refund consequence, however, is nil. This trip is RydeX, a fixed-fare (non-metered) service: the fare was quoted up front and distance variation during the trip does not change it [F6][RD-2]. The billed distance is 16.6 km, exactly the optimal route distance, so no detour kilometres entered the charge at all [F4][RD-2]. The components are base $3.90 + distance $23.39 + time $5.62 + platform $1.47 + waiting $0.00 − discount $0.00 = $34.38, with no surge (1.0×) and no unpublished add-on to strip out [F5][F6][FARE-1]. Under RD-2 for non-metered services the only recoverable items would be ERP/toll incurred on the unexempted segment or unpublished manually added fees; neither exists, and the dataset shows no toll component in the charge [F6][RD-2][FARE-2]. Recoverable amount = 0, so the outcome is no_action, while the RD-1 breach is recorded [F3][F6][RD-1][RD-2].

RD-6 is not triggered: the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so this case does not make the breach "repeated" and no account flag follows [F15][RD-6].

Because this was a fixed-fare RydeX trip, the rider's fare was unaffected and no refund is due. This is recorded on your file for monitoring only — no account action and no flag. Carry on as normal, and agree any route change with the rider before you leave the route.
